annotation_geometry.box_convention: zero-based native conditioned ROI pixels; x2/y2 exclusive

GeoPRR-Net.architecture: Shared EfficientNet-B0 dual-view geometry/polar/relational conditional-moment network
GeoPRR-Net.preprocessing: Official native conditioned ROI -> raw whole-ROI direct resize (INTER_AREA when downsizing, else INTER_LINEAR); a support-normalized SARN-v2 second view plus support mask/homography is derived from the same pixels. Effective SARN active only for non-clean conditions.
GeoPRR-Net.geometry_assistance: Pixel-only support-aware ROI normalization; no annotated RF100 pivot/endpoints are model inputs.

VDN.architecture: Official VDN ResNet-18 + 3 deconvolution heads, direction component retrained on matched SyncG split
VDN.preprocessing: Native condition first, then cv2 INTER_LINEAR to 384 square and normalized BGR tensor.
VDN.geometry_assistance: RF100 annotated pivot/minimum/maximum, transformed with the same condition and resized, used only for postprocessing direction into normalized progress; annotated pointer tip is not supplied to direction model.
VDN.target_domain_adaptation: None; SyncG train 12866/inner validation 1576; RF100 retrospective test only.

YOLO11s-Pose-4KP.checkpoint_selection: Best fixed inner validation fitness within 30 epochs
YOLO11s-Pose-4KP.preprocessing: Native condition first, OpenCV bilinear square resize to 384 then YOLO input processing.
YOLO11s-Pose-4KP.geometry_assistance: No RF100 geometric labels at inference; all four points predicted from provided ROI. Summary geometry_role describes target annotation source, whereas each actual prediction row confirms offline_geometry=null.
YOLO11s-Pose-4KP.target_domain_adaptation: None; SyncG train 12866/inner validation 1576; RF100 retrospective test only.

reconstruction_protocol.historical_random_rule: Existing _sample_orientation uses SHA256 of UTF-8 f"{seed}:{sample_id}"; digest[0] parity picks yaw/pitch, digest[1] parity picks sign. This is the original evaluation rule, not a new integrity mechanism.
reconstruction_protocol.perspective: warpPerspective INTER_LINEAR; border constant = median of native ROI border; 3% fit margin preserves complete projected plane
reconstruction_protocol.blur: perspective first, then GaussianBlur sigma=0.003*short_side (min 0.1 px), BORDER_REFLECT_101; only combined_severe here
reconstruction_protocol.model_resize: GeoPRR direct_resize_whole_roi: INTER_AREA when max native H/W >256 else INTER_LINEAR; structured comparators use INTER_LINEAR to their recorded square size.
reconstruction_protocol.export: Full native conditioned ROI, no labels, model overlays, sharpening, color editing or further dial cropping. Optional pointer detail is a separate exact pixel crop.
reconstruction_protocol.performed: canonical image loading, deterministic historical image transform, exact display crop, and existing numeric-record extraction only; no model loading/training/inference

method_protocols.GeoPRR-Net: Shared EfficientNet-B0 dual view, image-derived SARN-v2 support normalization, geometry/polar/relational routing; full fixed-epoch EMA per encoder. SyncG scene-disjoint test; RF100 frozen external transfer. Industrial adds supervised row_weighted residual feature heads with group-isolated five-fold OOF, frozen encoders, then equal weights across three encoder predictions.
method_protocols.VDN: Public ResNet-18 VDN direction component retrained on matched SyncG, terminal epoch 200. SyncG/RF100 annotation pivot/start/end conversion. Industrial cached automatic reference detector. No Industrial OOF fitting is claimed.
method_protocols.YOLO11s-Pose-4KP: Ultralytics YOLO11s four predicted points, best inner SyncG validation checkpoint within 30 epochs; no annotated reference geometry used at inference in any dataset; no target-domain adaptation.
method_protocols.DeepLabV3+-ROI: Pointer segmentation, best inner SyncG validation Dice checkpoint within 20 epochs. SyncG/RF100 annotation pivot/start/end; Industrial cached automatic geometry. No Industrial OOF fitting is claimed.
method_protocols.automatic_reference_detector: utils/angleDetect/yoloDetection/result/yolo_pointbest.pt, fixed auxiliary detector for Industrial VDN/DeepLab. Its training-data provenance is unresolved; strict end-to-end target-unseen status cannot be inferred.

missing_materials: No selected scalar prediction records are missing: 74 rows include four methods and all required seeds/OOF components.
YOLO11s predicted point arrays and DeepLab masks/probability images were not saved in these formal runs.
VDN saved scalar angles exist for SyncG only; RF100/Industrial have scalar telemetry but no saved direction vectors.
Industrial full-frame source files were not located. Original workbook embedded ROI pixels and formal ROI files were located and match exactly.
Conditioned stress images were reconstructed from existing formal native ROIs using the original transforms; all six match stored historical condition-pixel records.
protocol_caveats: Selection is outcome-based for qualitative inspection. These six examples do not estimate aggregate performance or its confidence interval.
Same image means the same native conditioned ROI before model-specific resizing and preprocessing, not identical network tensors or identical auxiliary information.
Industrial adapted OOF GeoPRR is compared with source-trained structured components under their actual different protocols. This is not a matched target-adaptation or all-OOF experiment.
SyncG source annotation split=train is an upstream storage designation; the experimental split is the separate scene-disjoint formal holdout.
RF100 targets were derived from detection annotation centers; this is not the official scalar-reading benchmark.
Fold IDs are the original zero-based IDs. Comparator fold_id is blank because the comparator was not fitted via Industrial OOF.
publication_status: Selected six-case release for KongyueX/GeoPRR-Net-Paper; no ZIP created
image_scope: Selected full-dial conditioned ROIs only, plus optional pointer crops. Industrial filenames and table identifiers reuse the existing anonymous IDs. This package conveys no license for the complete source collections.
